item.title: Can Technology Stop Earthquakes? The Engineering Truth
item.description: Discover if technology can stop earthquakes, and learn how modern structural engineering uses base isolation and dampeners to protect buildings.

item.title: How Phone Sensors Track Your Steps: The Tech Inside
item.description: Discover how your phone tracks steps using tiny MEMS accelerometers, motion algorithms, and hardware sensors. Learn the science behind everyday step counters.

item.title: How 3D Printed Houses Work: Inside Robotic Construction
item.description: Discover how 3D printed houses work. Explore the concrete extrusion process, gantry systems, robotic construction, and the software driving modern buildings.

item.title: How Vinyl Records Work: The Physics of Groove Sound
item.description: Discover how vinyl records work. Explore the physics of microscopic grooves, diamond styluses, and analog sound waves turning plastic into music.

item.title: How Smart Glasses Work: Inside Audio and Display Tech
item.description: Discover how smart glasses work behind the lenses. Explore the engineering of micro-displays, optical waveguides, bone-conduction audio, and modern sensors.
